title: Trying a Pottery Class
context: Ava 向社区中心工作人员 Noah 询问初学者手捏陶器课，并决定报名。 本课属于 2026-11-22 预制系列，内容和练习题均为原创，并非真实考试题。

dialogue.speaker: Ava
dialogue.en: I'm interested in the pottery class. Is it suitable for a beginner?
dialogue.zh: 我对陶艺课感兴趣。初学者适合参加吗？

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: Yes, the Saturday class starts with simple hand-built bowls.
dialogue.zh: 适合。周六的课从简单的手捏碗开始。

dialogue.speaker: Ava
dialogue.en: I've never worked with clay. Do I need to bring anything?
dialogue.zh: 我从来没玩过陶土。我需要带什么吗？

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: The teacher provides the clay and tools. You might want an old shirt.
dialogue.zh: 老师会提供陶土和工具。你也许想带件旧衬衫。

dialogue.speaker: Ava
dialogue.en: That sounds manageable. How long does the class last?
dialogue.zh: 听起来我能应付。课程多长时间？

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: This session runs for two hours, starting at ten.
dialogue.zh: 这次课从十点开始，持续两小时。

dialogue.speaker: Ava
dialogue.en: Will we take the bowls home that day?
dialogue.zh: 我们当天就能把碗带回家吗？

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: They need to dry and be fired first. The teacher will explain when to pick them up.
dialogue.zh: 需要先晾干并烧制。老师会说明什么时候可以来取。

dialogue.speaker: Ava
dialogue.en: I see. Is there still room in this Saturday's class?
dialogue.zh: 明白了。这周六的课还有名额吗？

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: There is one spot left. I can put your name on the list.
dialogue.zh: 还剩一个名额。我可以把你的名字记在名单上。

dialogue.speaker: Ava
dialogue.en: Please do. I'm Ava Chen, and I'm excited to try it.
dialogue.zh: 麻烦你了。我叫 Ava Chen，很期待试试。

dialogue.speaker: Noah
dialogue.en: You're on the list, Ava. We'll see you Saturday morning.
dialogue.zh: 已经登记好了，Ava。周六早上见。

expressions.example: This trail is suitable for beginners.

expressions.zh: 使用某种材料或与之打交道。
expressions.example: She likes to work with paper and fabric.
The meeting will last about an hour.
I'll pick up my repaired coat on Friday.

expressions.zh: 某活动或空间里有空位。
expressions.example: Is there room in the afternoon group?

pronunciation: pottery 重读第一个音节 POT；clay 以 /kl/ 开头，两个辅音紧接着发。

practice.title: Part 1 · Classes
practice.prompt: Would you like to take a class in your neighborhood?
practice.answer: Yes. I'd like to try pottery because I enjoy making things with my hands. It would also be a chance to meet people nearby.

practice.title: Part 2 · A skill you would like to learn
practice.prompt: Describe a practical skill you would like to learn. Say what it is, where you could learn it, and why it interests you.
practice.answer: I would like to learn to make simple pottery. A community center near me offers a class where beginners make bowls by hand. I would enjoy working with clay and seeing a useful object take shape. I know the bowls need time to dry and be fired, so I would have to wait before taking one home. I think the slow process would help me relax after work. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Community learning
practice.prompt: How can local classes benefit a neighborhood?
practice.answer: They give people a convenient place to learn and meet others. Offering different times and beginner classes can make it easier for more residents to join.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 跟读报名对话，再询问陶艺课是否适合初学者、是否提供材料。
practice.answer: Is the pottery class suitable for beginners? Do I need to bring any tools? I'd like to put my name on the list.
